memory_candidates.content: git ls-files -s (and therefore any check built on it, including ci.yml's and verify-all.sh's executable-bit scan) reads the git INDEX mode, not the working-tree filesystem mode. A bare `chmod +x` on a tracked file is invisible to this check until the mode change is staged with `git add`; seeding or testing such a check requires staging, not just a filesystem permission change.

To verify a bash aggregator script's error-path logic (e.g. an out-of-sync count guard) without re-running several minutes of real, slow child commands, make a throwaway scratch copy with the real invocations replaced by instant stand-ins (true/false), run the fast variant to exercise the aggregation/reporting logic in isolation, then discard the copy. This is a sound substitute for repeatedly re-running the full real script purely to test control-flow that does not depend on what the child commands actually do.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic scripts/verify-all.sh (task 941)
sapience_notes.value: git ls-files -s reads the git index mode, not the working-tree filesystem permission bits. An unstaged chmod +x on a tracked file is invisible to any check using 'git ls-files -s -- pattern | awk $1==100755', including .github/workflows/ci.yml's own executable-bit scan; the change must be staged via git add before such a check will see it.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic CI parity verification without network access
sapience_notes.value: In a sandboxed session with no outbound network, gh run view/gh run list fail with a tcp dial timeout rather than an auth error, making CI-run comparison impossible; the documented fallback is to verify parity against the CI workflow file's text (ci.yml) rather than an observed run.

In this sandbox that battery has 12 pre-existing failing suites, all tracing to tests resolving agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/... relative to the project root, while .claude-extensions.json's actual core source_dir is the absolute path /home/benjamin/.config/nvim/agent-system/extensions/core, not mounted at the relative location the tests expect. sapience_notes.subject: general-implementation-agent bounded-waiter discipline on a long local script
sapience_notes.value: A multi-check aggregator script compiling Lean sources (check-evidence-probes.sh, check-module-invariants.sh --no-build) took roughly 10-12 minutes end to end in this repository; a single foreground Bash call with the default 120s harness timeout auto-backgrounds such a run, so a captured-pid kill -0 liveness loop inside one outer `timeout` call is required to observe completion without ending the turn mid-wait.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic's nine-check CI gate (.github/workflows/ci.yml)
sapience_notes.value: ci.yml's step 9 (lint-style) is a single run: block with set -euo pipefail containing three sub-checks (lake exe lint-style, an executable-bit scan over *.lean, a case-insensitive tracked-path-collision scan); a mid-block failure there stops later sub-checks in CI, but the local aggregator deliberately runs all three unconditionally for stricter local coverage.
